description: This file defines a React functional component named CountdownTimer, which counts down from a specified number of seconds and calls an optional callback on expiration. It manages its own countdown state, updates every second, and displays the remaining time formatted as MM:SS.

methods.name: CountdownTimer({ seconds = 0, onExpire })
methods.description: React functional component implementing a countdown timer that accepts 'seconds' and an optional 'onExpire' callback.
